id.description: Unique dialog ID used by the native opener and close button.

heading.description: Visible heading that names the dialog.

children.description: Trusted semantic content, including navigation, forms, and nested overlays.

trigger.description: Optional trusted markup inside the trigger button. Visible text supplies the accessible name unless triggerAriaLabel is set.

triggerAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for an icon-only trigger. If the trigger has visible text, include that text.

side.description: Viewport side. Inline start and end follow the writing direction.

size.description: Preferred width for inline drawers or height for top and bottom drawers.

description.description: Brief text announced with the dialog heading. Omit for complex content.

footer.description: Optional trusted action markup after the scrollable drawer body.

rounded.description: Round the corners of the edge facing the page content. Edges are square by default.

actionRequired.description: Omit the close button and disable Escape and light dismissal, so the drawer closes only through a control inside it. Provide that control in the content or footer.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the icon-only close button.

focusHeading.description: Focus the heading when opened. Set false to focus the control marked autofocus in the content; without one, the close button receives focus.

triggerClassName.description: Classes for the trigger button, including optional USWDS button variants. No classes are applied by default.

panelClassName.description: Additional classes for the dialog panel.
